question: With the default pipeline otherwise, does routing bus groups (two-pin nets whose start and end pins lie pairwise within 5 mm, at least 3 nets) as middle-out blocks in pass 1 (krt-bus ordering), with each member drawn to its routed neighbour by a non-negative maze-search cost (krt-bus bundle), lower the vias or the trace length on bus nets against Freerouting, without leaving more connections unrouted, new clearance violations or vias in pads?
hypothesis: none registered: the X11 checklist names no expected direction; the measurement decides whether the stages stay registered

freerouting.engine: freerouting-rs at the commit that lands X11, after P04's default-tree decision, in-process through freerouting-krt's harness (the CLI does not call freerouting_krt::register before C07)
freerouting.command: X11_DSN={DSN} X11_ARMS=freerouting X11_SES_DIR={SES_DIR} cargo test --release -p freerouting-krt --test bus bus_arms_on_a_set -- --ignored --exact --nocapture

krt-bus-order.command: X11_DSN={DSN} X11_ARMS=krt-bus-order X11_SES_DIR={SES_DIR} cargo test --release -p freerouting-krt --test bus bus_arms_on_a_set -- --ignored --exact --nocapture

krt-bus.command: X11_DSN={DSN} X11_ARMS=krt-bus X11_SES_DIR={SES_DIR} cargo test --release -p freerouting-krt --test bus bus_arms_on_a_set -- --ignored --exact --nocapture

settings.autorouter.algorithm: krt-bus (the krt-bus ordering and the krt-bus-attraction connection router with AttractionParams::default: weight 1, cap 5 mm, any layer, two-sided, pass 1)

boards.eligibility_rule: a board with at least one bus group of freerouting_krt::bus::detect on the input board (bus_groups_on_a_set), running between connectors, memory or bus parts

eligibility: every board of the set; a board where a candidate and the baseline have equal bus vias and bus length within 0.1 mm is neutral, printed; a board not graded (a crash, a timeout, exit 2 of a grader) fails that board for the arm that was not graded and is never a pass

grading.coldfire: tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh on the KiCad demo kit-dev-coldfire-xilinx_5213 prepared as X01 prepared it, with the arm's command as ENGINE_COMMAND: drc_real, kicad_unconnected and via_in_pad from the grader; if the grader cannot run, Rust's DRC grades it and the amendment says so
grading.others: no .kicad_pcb in the repository: graded by Rust's DRC inside the harness (drc_new: all_clearance_violations of the routed board with an item the run created) and its via-in-pad test

metrics.name: drc_real
metrics.source: the KiCad grader where it runs; drc_new from Rust's DRC otherwise

metrics.name: unrouted
metrics.source: kicad_unconnected on KiCad-graded boards; the routed board's airlines (DesignRulesChecker::all_airlines) otherwise; any increase is a regression

metrics.name: bus_vias
metrics.source: vias on a net of a detected bus group

metrics.name: spacing_um
metrics.source: X11.3's spacing: same-layer centreline distance between physical neighbours over their common length

pass_rule.improve: bus_vias lower, or bus_length_mm lower by more than tol with bus_vias not higher
pass_rule.regress: unrouted higher, or a hard metric above 0

keep_rule: each candidate arm is judged on its own (krt-bus as candidate_arm, then krt-bus-order with the same rules in a second gate run): it stays registered (off by default) only if bus vias or bus length improve on N-1 of the graded boards, unrouted regresses on none, and via_in_pad and drc_real are 0 on every board. Otherwise its registration and code are removed (krt-bus-order without the attraction: bus/attraction.rs, the bundle and the engine cost hook go; neither: the bus module goes) and the numbers stay in X11.4's note. Either way it is never a default from this run.

decision_table.keep: the arm stays registered; docs/DIVERGENCES.md gets its line (a selectable ordering or connection router Java does not have)
decision_table.reject: the arm's registration and code go; X11.4 records the numbers

stop_rule: one run per board and arm; no re-run except for a crash or a not-graded board, which is re-run once and reported
timing: the registered run waits for P04's default-tree decision (P00 README 'Order', Q00 README 'Order and critical path'); X11.4's partial note gives a pre-P04 dry run at the landing tree, labelled as such, not this registration's result

amendments.reason: Before the first engine run of the registered run (after P04's decision, c23d8c0: the default tree stays Java's). (1) The grading clause routes kit-dev-coldfire through tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh on the KiCad demo prepared as X01 prepared it, so the input the arms route is the DSN grade.sh exports from that prepared board, not the fixture fixtures/Issue690-kit-dev-coldfire-xilinx_5213.dsn: the row is renamed kit-dev-coldfire-xilinx_5213 and registered with the prepared board's sha256 (X01's and X06's registration; target/orchestrator/x01/boards/kit-dev-coldfire-xilinx_5213/prepared). The exported DSN embeds its work path in its first line; its body hashes to 4758a3f1b85f0969f4adbc47d0bf0f3c26448677fbe7023f1e32a27068c9a6d0. (2) The harness starts from an empty settings patch (default_profile in the crate's test file), not TestingProfile::default(), whose copper-to-edge clearance 0 (java_fixture_test) biased the pre-P04 dry run. Each route runs under a 45 min timeout; a timed-out arm is not graded, which the eligibility rule already makes a failed board for that arm.
